text.text_excerpt: Lucky Jean Seafood is ran by a group of happy, energetic, fun and friendly people. Their energy lights up the place, but the restaurant itself lacks any charm. There are tables to dine in the restaurant, but the walls are barren and the colors are drab; I would just recommend getting your food to go. I was lured to the place by the sign outside stating that they sold seafood by the pound and the constant flow of traffic didn't hurt either. Well, when I entered and saw the large container of Crawfish on the counter, I was super excited. Once I got that first crawfish in my mouth, it further increased my excitement. It was really good. Great flavor and spicy! I ordered a plate of their Gene...

Lucky Jean is our go place for quick food. My parents like their salads, I enjoy their chicken wings which are whole wings, second favorite in the East. They have chicken wing plates that come with two sides and a fountain drink. I usually get my plate with red bean. The bean are usually pretty good, but this last time they were rather watery. I enjoy join their French fries, I always order a small for my ride home. They offer a wide variety of things to choose from: seafood plates and sandwiches, Chinese plates, boiled seafood, etc. I've tried it all. I have, however, been disappointed with the shrimp of buns and poboys, they have become very skimpy with the shrimp. They have more to cho...

YOU HAD ME AT HELLO!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!! Love this CRAWFISH and CRABS. Not too spicy just perfect with spices and flavor. Lines move fast now I am just wondering if there is more good stuff out there. It is pretty clean in the new location. I was pleasantly surprised at the taste of the crawfish. I definitely ranked this place pretty high on the crawfish roster. They have a pretty wide menu and selection of other foods I would like to try. I am definitely leaning on reviewers for any feedback on the poboys. I don't know where I would be without a good oyster poboy in my life.
